title: WildRelight: A Real-World Benchmark and Physics-Guided Adaptation for Single-Image Relighting
abstract: arXiv:2605.11696v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent single-image relighting methods, powered by advanced generative models, have achieved impressive photorealism on synthetic benchmarks. However, their effectiveness in the complex visual landscape of the real world remains largely unverified. A critical gap exists, as current datasets are typically designed for multi-view reconstruction and fail to address the unique challenges of single-image relighting. To bridge this synthetic-to-real gap, we introduce WildRelight, the first in-the-wild dataset specifically created for evaluating single-image relighting models. WildRelight features a diverse collection of high-resolution outdoor scenes, captured under strictly aligned, temporally varying natural illuminations, each paired with a high-dynamic-range environment map. translated_title: WildRelight：面向单图像重光照的真实世界基准与物理引导自适应方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.11696v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：近年来，由先进生成模型驱动的单图像重光照方法在合成基准上已取得了令人印象深刻的照片级真实感效果。然而，这些方法在复杂真实世界视觉环境中的有效性在很大程度上仍未得到验证。当前存在一个关键差距：现有数据集通常是为多视图重建而设计的，无法应对单图像重光照所面临的独特挑战。为了弥合这一从合成到真实的差距，我们提出了 WildRelight，这是首个专门为评估单图像重光照模型而创建的野外真实数据集。WildRelight 包含丰富多样的高分辨率户外场景集合，这些场景是在严格对齐、随时间变化的自然光照条件下采集的，且每个场景均配有高动态范围环境贴图。利用这些数据，我们建立了一个严格的基准测试，揭示了在合成数据上训练的最先进模型存在严重的域偏移问题。
tldr: 本文提出了首个用于评估单图像重光照模型的野外真实数据集 WildRelight，通过严格基准测试揭示了现有在合成数据上训练的最先进模型存在严重的域偏移问题，并提出了物理引导的自适应方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WildRelight, the first in-the-wild dataset for evaluating single-image relighting models, and establishes a rigorous benchmark revealing that state-of-the-art models trained on synthetic data suffer from severe domain shifts, along with a physics-guided adaptation approach.
